description: The embedded provider/model catalog — providers, models, capabilities (vision · reasoning · json_mode), context windows, and API-key env-var NAMES (values never read). Versioned wire `catalog_version: 1`. Pick REAL model ids from here instead of guessing — and pick them ONLY from rows where `resolves` is true. A cataloged vendor is not a runnable one: `resolves: false` means this binary has no adapter for it and `nika check` refuses the model at the MODELS rung.
